representations.name: taxed quadratic recurrence
representations.new_information: Retains the exact linear tax while extracting B_(n+1)>=B_n^2/4.
representations.first_test: Use B_n>=20n to check the residual polynomial.

representations.name: logarithmic height potential
representations.new_information: Converts taxed squaring into the affine recurrence log B_(n+1)>=2 log B_n-2.

representations.name: double-exponential barrier
representations.new_information: Packages B_n>=2^(2+2^(n-2)) as an explicit wall threshold.
representations.first_test: Verify the exponent maps exactly under squaring divided by four.

representations.name: actual strip bit bound
representations.new_information: Bounds q_j directly from its dyadic formula without asymptotic notation.
representations.first_test: Prove q_j<2^(j+6) for all odd j.

representations.name: ceiling selector
representations.new_information: Chooses p(j)=2+ceil(log2(j+4)) with exact integer rounding.

representations.name: first-wall composition
representations.new_information: Turns B_p>q into recovery by or before rank p using round eight.
representations.first_test: Separate earlier stable recovery from forced wall recovery.

representations.name: bit-length computational guard
representations.new_information: Checks large j without constructing full Macaulay orbits.
representations.first_test: Test the exponent comparison through j=1000001 under resource bounds.

representations.name: no-uniformity compatibility ledger
representations.new_information: Separates an unbounded explicit memberwise bound from a uniform rank.
representations.first_test: Compare p(j) tending to infinity with round four's quantifiers.

representations.name: public rank-42 firewall
representations.new_information: Records why O(log j) on one family is not the public seed theorem.
representations.first_test: Require all-orbit coverage and suffix persistence.
